TASK.TEXT: At the bottom of the trench, past the last
glow of daylight, strange lanterns drift by.
They belong to deep-sea fish, who use their
lights to lure in curious little prey.
Here the water is near freezing and the
weight of the ocean presses on every side.
Only the sturdiest submarines can survive,
with thick hulls and tiny round windows.
Yet even down here, life finds a way. Tube
worms sway beside warm vents, crabs scuttle
over black rock, and somewhere in the dark
a legendary treasure waits for its finder.
